name: Aurore Lalucq - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on facilitating the financing of investments and reforms to boost European competitiveness and creating a Capital Markets Union (Draghi Report)
part_text:
Europe's economy is falling behind the United States and China. This report says the EU needs at least 750 to 800 billion euros of extra investment every year. It asks the EU to build a true single market for capital, so savings can flow into companies instead of sitting in bank accounts. It also wants stronger public support for high-risk areas like defence and clean technology, and better financial education for citizens. The report is an opinion: it asks the European Commission to act but does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose laws on investment, savings products and supervision.
- **Who it affects:** Savers, small companies, start-ups, pension funds, banks and national governments.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides which proposals to make; Parliament wants a mid-term review by mid-2027.
